newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Skilled sees 15 pct fall in full yr profit.
newsitem.headline: Skilled sees 15 pct fall in full yr profit.

text.p: Skilled Engineering Ltd said on Friday that its net profit for the year to June 30, 1997 was expected to be more than 15 percent below the A$12.6 million it achieved last year.
Skilled said its sales and profits had been affected by a review by Optus Communications of the roll-out of cable-TV infrastructure.
Skilled had been carrying out five major projects related to the roll-out of cable-TV networks for Optus, but its scheduled work had been "significantly reduced" following the review, it said.
"It is therefore likely that net profit after tax for the full year will be more than 15 percent less than the level achieved in the previous year," the company said in a statement.
Skilled is due to release its third-quarter result in mid-May.
